facts.value: Before transition/setup, writes allow_interrupt=false and cmd_vars[0]=0 only. Repeatedly samples HSD_Randi(3)+ftPe_MS_AttackS4Club across consecutive Club, Pan, and Racket states until the candidate differs from saved attacks4_motion_id. Stores the accepted ID before Fighter_ChangeMotionState(gobj, msid, Ft_MF_None, 0, 1, 0, NULL), then calls ftAnim_8006EBA4. The float arguments are animation start 0, speed 1 and blend 0. An out-of-range saved ID accepts the first candidate. The no-repeat invariant concerns saved selection, which ftPe_Init_OnDeath resets to ftCo_MS_None. Each attempt advances shared RNG state; integer scaling does not establish exact equal probabilities and the loop has no explicit retry limit. Initial local flag writes are not a guarantee about return-time flags after downstream setup.
